physicalNotes: Radius 0.26853468 Jupiter radii from Turtelboom et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163..293T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..293T/abstract): 19,198.1 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.02548545 Jupiter masses (Turtelboom et al. 2022, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2022AJ....163..293T), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..293T/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. sources.period: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): P 4.30745132484 d

sources.phase: ExoFOP, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname EXOFOP): transit mid-time 2459737.587215 BJD, taken as BJD_TDB; with its period, the row that predicts 2026-01-01 best (1 sigma 4 min)
sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
